svg.title: Azure scopes within one Microsoft Entra tenant
svg.desc: Layout follows the Azure scopes diagram on Microsoft Learn. A vertical tree with row labels on the right. Top: one Microsoft Entra tenant. Below it, a management group with two management groups under it. The left management group holds one subscription bought under an Enterprise Agreement (EA). The right management group holds two subscriptions, one under a Cloud Solution Provider agreement (CSP) and one under a Microsoft Customer Agreement (MCA). Each subscription has a resource group, and each resource group holds resources. The billing offer written next to each subscription is how that subscription is paid for. Icons are official Azure and Microsoft Entra icons.
svg.text: Azure scopes within one Microsoft Entra tenant
EA, MCA and CSP are billing offers. The offer decides how a subscription is paid for.
